results.title: Multimodal perishable fruits and vegetables dataset
results.description: Comprehensive lifecycle coverage: The dataset documents the full lifecycle of fruits, from the unripe stage to the visible spoilage stage, using multimodal data. Measurements are captured three times daily—morning, afternoon, and evening—recording natural variations in temperature, color, and methane emission patterns.
